content:
jordan: Hey team — first day! quick q about cloud access: I need to be able to assume the AWS role used for Dedicated pools and get access to the GCP project where our private deployments live (redwood-prod-inference). Who do I contact for billing and region-specific permissions? Do I also need to be added to any org groups?

maya: welcome 👋 For AWS you should be given the IAM role named 'Redwood/DedicatedAccess' so you can assume it from your user. For GCP we usually grant Project Viewer + Service Account User on the deployment SA. The onboarding doc has the steps: https://go.redwood.internal/onboarding/cloud-access

maya: if you need the quick commands, here's what infra usually runs (replace role-arn / sa-email):
```bash
# AWS assume-role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-DedicatedAccess --role-session-name jordan-session

# GCP auth and IAM binding (example)
gcloud auth login
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod-inference --member='user:jordan@redwood.com' --role='roles/viewer'
```

jordan: thanks — do you have the exact service account email and the AWS role ARN I should reference? Also, my team runs inference in europe-west1 a lot — will I need any region-specific IAM or quota permissions?

maya: AWS role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-DedicatedAccess
GCP SA: platform-deploy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
About regions: GCP IAM is org/project-level, but we sometimes need region quotas increased (e.g., GPUs in europe-west1). If you need GPUs, file a quota request via the cloud console and cc @infra-oncall.

lisa: for billing access, we need Finance to add you to the billing account with Billing Account Viewer. Please open an internal request at https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/BillingRequest and tag @finance. They usually ask for your org email and reason. :moneybag:

infra-bot: Created ticket #INF-482: "Grant jordan cloud access (AWS assume-role + GCP project SA)". Assigned to infra-oncall. ETA: 1 business day.

infra-oncall: Hey @jordan I picked this up. Will do the AWS role trust and add the GCP Viewer binding. Quick note: we require 2FA + security key enrollment before we grant cross-account roles. Let me know if you need help with security key setup.

jordan: got it — I'll open the billing request now and attach my security key setup steps. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
